clauses.text: 1.1  Requirements for manufacture, dimensions and tolerances, and marking  for injection moulded and machined HDPE pipe ends  for potable water supplies. SUMMARY OF IS 8008 (PART 6) : 2003 INJECTION MOULDED HIGH DENSITY POLYETHYLENE (HDPE) FITTINGS FOR POTABLE WATER SUPPLIES PART 6 SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS FOR  PIPE ENDS (First Revision) Note —For general requirements regarding material, manufacture, methods of test, etc, refer to IS  8008 (Part  1)  : 2003.
